title: Upload a media file
description: Upload one photo or video into a writable folder.
parameters: file: multipart file; photo: JSON with nsId and visibility (0 private, 1 public).

title: Upload multiple media files
description: Upload files with one description per file, in the same order.
parameters: files: repeated multipart files; photosStr: JSON array of nsId and visibility objects.

title: Delete a media file
description: Delete the selected media and its associated data.
returns: 1 on success; legacy path-token errors may return negative codes.

title: Download original media
description: Read original media with its correct Content-Type. Video byte ranges are supported.

title: Get root folder
description: Find the root folder for this account.

title: List child folders
description: List visible folders below a parent.

title: List folder media (legacy)
description: Existing unpaginated folder listing. Prefer List media for large libraries.

title: List media
description: Page through visible media, newest ID first. Optionally limit to a folder.
parameters: nsId: optional folder ID; after: previous nextAfter cursor; limit: 1–200 (default 100).

title: Get media details
description: Read media identity, format, folder, content version, Live Photo/animation flags and categories.
parameters: uuid: media UUID in the address.
returns: {msgCode:200,t:media}; excludes private Notes, People and share tokens.

title: Get static thumbnail
description: Read the current static cover, including generated video thumbnails.
parameters: uuid: media UUID in the address.
returns: Binary image. A pending thumbnail returns an availability error.

title: List categories
description: Read six category counts and up to three preview media per category.

title: List category media
description: Page through media in a category, newest ID first.
parameters: category: video, panorama, live, animated, screenshot or portrait; after and limit: as List media.
